historical_record.description: In 1969 the firehouse here, built in 1923 and remodelled in 1955, was Fire Station 39, home to Engine 39. It had two storeys, two apparatus bays and a ground floor of 4,860 sq ft; the city's fire-station study that year called its dormitory adequate and its condition poor.
